summary: Rebekah Mercer (born 1973), a Stanford-trained former trader at Renaissance Technologies, runs the political and philanthropic giving of her father Robert Mercer. She led the pro-Cruz super PAC in 2016, then helped install Steve Bannon and Kellyanne Conway in Trump's campaign and served on his transition executive committee. She co-founded and controls the social network Parler, broke with Bannon in 2018, and is reported as a co-founder of the venture firm 1789 Capital with Omeed Malik and Chris Buskirk, where Donald Trump Jr. is a partner.
